description: This file defines the NumberFormatter class responsible for formatting integers into roman numerals or alphabetic sequences, with support for uppercase/lowercase variants and handling of large or zero values.

classes.name: NumberFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting numbers as roman numerals or alphabetic characters.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats an integer into a string based on specified format options (ROMAN, alphabetic, etc.).

methods.name: AsRoman
methods.description: Converts an integer into its roman numeral representation, handling lowercase and size restrictions.

methods.name: AsLetters
methods.description: Converts an integer into a sequence of alphabetic characters, supporting uppercase and lowercase, and handling size restrictions.
